about: The db-benchmark join questions (docs/named-benchmarks.md section 5.2) as commands. {X}, {SMALL}, {MEDIUM}, {BIG} are the files' paths. 'flags' and 'query' are the argv after the binary; both must give the reference's fingerprint (scripts/bench_named_join_ref.py --gate). Class E expressible, B expressible up to a bound (q5's build side is N rows). No time is recorded here: the driver (scripts/bench_named.py --suite join) reads this file.
label: H2O-join layout, own generator, seed 108: not the h2oai R generator, so published numbers are not comparable

questions.name: small inner on int
questions.sql: SELECT * FROM x JOIN small USING (id1)
query: select a.id1, a.id2, a.id3, a.id4, a.id5, a.id6, a.v1, b.id4, b.v2 from '{X}' as a join '{SMALL}' as b on a.id1 = b.id1
questions.note: the build side is the --join file (the right table); --join-prefix names its columns right_*; the canonical row is x's seven cells then the right table's other cells (v2 last)
